chemomodulatory effects of phytochemicals in triggering the inactivation of EGFR receptor, MAPK (ERK) and PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling pathway in carcinogenesis

(A) chemomodulatory effects of phytochemicals in triggering the inactivation of EGFR receptor, MAPK (ERK) and PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling pathway in carcinogenesis. (B) modulatory effect of phytochemicals in inhibiting/reducing the transcriptional activation of beta-catenin/TCF complex. (C) inhibitory effects of phytochemicals on the VEGF, uPA and MMP pathways involved in stimulating the migration and angiogenesis processes of cancer cells leading to metastasis
